|---|---|---|
| `commands/common-ground.md` | common-ground | Surface and validate Claude's hidden assumptions about the project for user confirmation |
| `commands/project/discovery/approve-synthesis.md` | approve-synthesis | Approve synthesis findings and create implementation tickets from discovery |
| `commands/project/discovery/create-epic-discovery.md` | create-epic-discovery | Create a discovery document for research/customer discovery epics |
| `commands/project/discovery/synthesize-discovery.md` | synthesize-discovery | Synthesize discovery findings into a consolidated analysis document with proposed tickets |
| `commands/project/execution/complete-ticket.md` | complete-ticket | Complete a ticket after execution - transitions Jira to "In Review" and updates the implementation plan |
| `commands/project/execution/execute-ticket.md` | execute-ticket | Execute a Jira ticket following its implementation plan |
| `commands/project/planning/create-epic-plan.md` | create-epic-plan | Create an epic planning document by analyzing Jira tickets and codebase |
| `commands/project/planning/create-implementation-plan.md` | create-implementation-plan | Generate an implementation plan from a planning document |
| `commands/project/retrospectives/complete-epic.md` | complete-epic | Complete an epic after all tickets are executed, generate report, and close in Jira |
| `commands/project/retrospectives/complete-sprint.md` | complete-sprint | Generate comprehensive sprint retrospective from completed epics |
